conclusion: Specific English phrases improve class semantics but do not make this image fully accurate.

variants.name: baseline
variants.assessment: High recall; truck is mislabeled as bus and some distant vehicles have duplicate boxes.

variants.name: multiple_specific_aliases
variants.assessment: Fewer boxes, but aliases add overlaps; truck and an extra weak person candidate remain.

variants.name: coach_bus_with_broad_car
variants.assessment: Coach is classified correctly; the truck is still mislabeled as car.

variants.name: strict_single_phrases
variants.assessment: Best semantic precision of the tested variants, but the truck is still mislabeled as passenger car and two near non-sedan vehicles are omitted.

recommendation: Keep v1 unchanged. If strict category semantics are preferred, create a new version using coach bus, passenger car, and person; do not claim full accuracy without an explicit truck exclusion rule.
